title: vs/v1/hive/display/{id} (retained): what the hive wants a hornet's screen to show

items.description: Empty: nothing chosen (a monitor says so; the old meteo-c3oled build shows its own readings). Without size on any item: the automatic layout of up to 4 lines. With size: every item is drawn where x, y say, at that size

label.description: What it is (a zone, a device); may be absent

x.description: Placed layout: pixels from the left edge to the anchor of the text (align says which edge of the text). Absent: 0

y.description: Placed layout: pixels from the top edge to the top of the text (of the label when there is one; the label is drawn in the smallest font above the value). Absent: 0

size.description: Relative text height: size/10 of the screen height, at least 6 px; the screen takes its largest font not taller than that. Set on any item: the whole screen is placed by x, y, size

align.description: Placed layout: which edge of the text x is. Absent: left
